# Generated by data/scripts/05_publish.py, do not edit by hand.

Small, pinned snapshots so nothing here depends on a live service.

| File                     | Source                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | License                                  |
|--------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------|
| ground_truth.json        | Generated reference numbers for the checks                                                                                                                                                                                                     | CC0                                      |
| site.gpkg                | OpenStreetMap, snapshot 2026-08-29; layers site (Poe Field), places (the five sample points), buildings_site, section                                                                                                                          | ODbL 1.0, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors |
| flight.json              | The flight's metadata as the camera and the pilot recorded it, without the operator's details                                                                                                                                                  | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| photos.csv               | The flight's photographs as a table: time, position, altitude, attitude and exposure from each file's EXIF and XMP                                                                                                                             | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| ortho_10cm.tif           | The flight's orthomosaic around the field at 10 cm, a Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF with JPEG tiles, overviews and a mask, resampled by averaging from the OpenDroneMap output; the full resolution file is on the release named in flight.json      | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| dsm_25cm.tif             | The flight's surface model at 25 cm, resampled bilinearly from the OpenDroneMap output; heights as the aircraft's receiver placed them, not NAVD88                                                                                             | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| dtm_50cm.tif             | The flight's terrain model at 50 cm, OpenDroneMap's ground classification interpolated and resampled bilinearly; the same heights as the surface model                                                                                         | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| report.json              | OpenDroneMap's processing statistics and the full orthophoto's metadata                                                                                                                                                                        | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| exif_opensfm.csv         | The software's own reading of every photograph's EXIF: the camera prior, the position and its assumed accuracy, the orientation prior it did not use, the readout time                                                                         | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| overlap_count.tif        | The software's count of photographs that see each ground cell, from its report, at 24 cm                                                                                                                                                       | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| photo_a.jpg              | The photograph that sees the pinned window best, downsized to 2000 pixels with its EXIF, GPS and XMP kept and the serial numbers dropped                                                                                                       | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| photo_b.jpg              | The pair's second photograph, the strongest match partner of photo_a beyond an 8 m baseline, downsized the same way                                                                                                                            | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| photo_c.jpg              | The next photograph by coverage of the window, downsized the same way                                                                                                                                                                          | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| undistorted_a.jpg        | photo_a as the software undistorted it for dense matching, downsized to 2000 pixels                                                                                                                                                            | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| undistorted_b.jpg        | photo_b as the software undistorted it, downsized to 2000 pixels                                                                                                                                                                               | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| features_pair.npz        | The software's features of the pair: normalised x and y, scale and angle of every point, and the 128 descriptor values as integers                                                                                                             | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| features_group.npz       | The software's feature points of the eight-photograph neighbourhood, without descriptors                                                                                                                                                       | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| matches_group.npz        | The software's robust matches within the neighbourhood, feature index pairs, the earlier photograph first                                                                                                                                      | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| pairs.csv                | Every pair of photographs the software considered: whether it was a candidate, how many robust matches survived, how many tracks they share                                                                                                    | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| tracks.npz               | Every observation of a reconstructed point (shot, point, feature, normalised x and y) and the length of every track of the flight                                                                                                              | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| block.npz                | The software's reconstruction: every shot's rotation, translation and receiver position in the adjustment's own frame and in the map frame, the sparse points in both, the calibrated camera and the prior, the affine between the frames      | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| reconstruction_steps.csv | How the software grew the block: the bootstrap pair, then each photograph resected with its inliers and the points triangulated after it                                                                                                       | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| depth_a.npz              | The software's depth map of photo_a: a depth, a normal and a confidence per pixel at a quarter of the photograph's size, with its camera                                                                                                       | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| dense_window.npz         | The software's filtered dense cloud inside the pinned window, as offsets from the window's centre, with colours, the views per point and the ground classes                                                                                    | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| mesh_window.npz          | The software's 2.5D mesh inside the pinned window, vertices as offsets from the centre and triangles                                                                                                                                           | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| dsm_window.tif           | The surface model over the pinned window at the software's own 5 cm; heights as the receiver placed them, not NAVD88                                                                                                                           | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| dtm_window.tif           | The terrain model over the pinned window at the software's own 5 cm, its ground classification interpolated; the same heights                                                                                                                  | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| ortho_window.tif         | The orthomosaic over the pinned window at the software's own 3 cm, JPEG tiles; the same window as P03's ortho_full_crop.tif                                                                                                                    | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| dense_sample.npz         | 100 000 points of the software's classified dense cloud of the whole flight, as points of the map frame (the products' system minus the offset in flight.json), with colours and ASPRS class codes; the same sample as P03's points_sample.npz | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |
| mesh_whole.npz           | The software's 2.5D mesh of the whole flight, thinned to every fourth vertex and triangulated again in plan with edges over 3 m dropped; vertices in the map frame, triangles as vertex indices                                                | CC BY 4.0, CEE420 Urban AI course flight |

Retrieved 2026-10-21 by the course data pipeline.
